title: Chinese nationals detained after drone incursions at MacDill and Langley
place_text: MacDill Air Force Base and Langley Air Force Base

tellings.quote: Based on what we know from previous incursions at McDill and Langley Air Force Base this year as well, um, that there were Chinese nationals that were taken into custody.

plain: In 2024, drones flew into the airspace of MacDill and Langley Air Force Bases, and Chinese nationals were taken into custody afterwards, according to Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he helped recover a UFO. Barber tells Michels this as something known about earlier incursions that year, without naming a source. He raises it to suggest that some of the drones seen over bases have human, foreign operators.
